text_blocks.snippet: To check the exit and re-entry visa status in Saudi Arabia, you can use the Muqeem portal or Absher platform. You'll need to log in with your digital identity (Absher account) and have the relevant details of the person whose visa status you're checking.
snippet_highlighted_words: use the Muqeem portal or Absher platform

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a breakdown of the process using both platforms:

list.snippet: Visit the Muqeem portal: Go to the official Muqeem website (https://muqeem.sa/).
Log in: If you have an existing account, log in. If not, register for an account.
Enter required information: Enter the Iqama number or visa number of the individual.
Cross-check details (optional): You may also need to provide additional details like date of birth, passport number, or visa expiry date.
View status: Click "Check" to view the visa validity, type, date of issue, and other details.
Log in to Absher: Access the Absher platform (https://www.absher.sa/) and log in.
Navigate to Visa Services: Select "Visa Services" under "My Services".
Choose Exit/Re-Entry Visa Status Inquiry: Select this option from the menu.
Enter details: Provide the required information, such as the Iqama number and visa number.
View status: Absher will display the visa validity, including the issue and expiration dates.
